name: com.stasync.relaynet
description: Networking for Unity. Replicates game objects, their state and RPCs between clients in a Relay room (https://github.com/stasync/relay-dotnet), over Keel's reliable UDP (https://github.com/stasync/keel-dotnet). Includes an offline mode that emulates the relay in-process.

samples.description: Each client spawns a capsule and moves it with WASD; the other clients see it move. Plays offline until you set a relay room on the Demo object.
